chunks.text: Employee travel reimbursement policy. Staff may claim business trip costs by uploading receipts within thirty days. Meals are limited to sixty dollars per day. 员工差旅报销：提交发票与审批记录，出差结束后三十天内申请。
The finance team reviews expense claims every Friday. An approved claim is paid to the employee bank account in the next payroll cycle. 财务每周五审核报销，批准后随工资发放。
Password reset guide. To regain access to a locked account, use the recovery link and verify your identity with a one-time code. 联系服务台解锁账户，使用身份验证码重设密码。
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for administrator accounts. Never share a recovery code. 管理员必须启用多因素认证，恢复码不可共享。

Database backup and recovery procedure. A nightly snapshot preserves the database. After accidental deletion, restore the latest verified snapshot and replay the transaction log. 数据库备份每天夜间执行；误删后从已验证快照恢复并重放事务日志。
Test a restoration every month on an isolated machine. Record the checksum and recovery duration. 每月在隔离设备进行恢复演练，记录校验和及耗时。
个人信息保留期限：客户合同到期后，个人资料最多保留九十天，随后安全删除。Data retention policy: personal customer records are kept for ninety days after a contract ends, then securely erased.
Attendance policy. A student who misses a class because of illness must provide a medical certificate within seven days to request an excused absence. 学生因病缺课须在七天内提供医生证明，申请病假豁免。
Deployment checklist: run unit tests, record the release commit, apply migrations and perform health checks before switching traffic. 发布检查：运行测试，登记版本，执行迁移并核验健康检查。
Project meeting minutes: Alice owns scanning, Bob owns PDF parsing, Carol owns search and David owns the interface. Next review is Monday. 项目会议明确扫描、解析、检索与界面的负责人。
Annual leave requests require manager approval at least five working days before the holiday. 员工申请年假须提前五个工作日获得经理批准。
Laboratory safety: wear protective glasses and gloves while handling chemicals. Know the location of emergency exits and eye wash stations. 实验室操作化学品时应佩戴护目镜和手套。
Supplier invoice processing requires a purchase order number and vendor tax identifier. Payment terms are forty-five days. 供应商发票须包含采购单号与税号，付款周期为四十五天。
The library opens at eight in the morning and closes at ten at night on weekdays. 图书馆工作日早上八点开放，晚上十点关闭。
Network troubleshooting: check the Ethernet cable, confirm the gateway address and run a DNS lookup before escalating to the network team. 网络故障排查先检查网线、网关和域名解析。
